propositions: Closing a ticket with no file impact in the accepted ticket/descendant scope unconditionally scans the full git history and resolves all historical ticket references before the empty-impact check that would skip landing enforcement.
The commit discovery work in `_referencing_commits` completes before `_check_file_impact_vs_diff` returns early for empty accepted-scope file impact, causing five-minute delays on no-impact closes.

Adding an early guard based on the union of ticket and accepted-descendant file impact should return before `_referencing_commits` is called, skipping unnecessary commit discovery when impact is empty.
Existing landing checks, impact-vs-diff enforcement, descendant-credit logic, and completion-verifier behavior must remain unchanged when any in-scope file impact exists.
